 Welcome to Ginny Lane
 
 
 
 
 Your appetite might lead you here. But our sensational food, breathtaking view, and exciting atmosphere will keep you coming back!
 
 At Ginny Lane, we have always been known for our fun, family-friendly atmosphere, and our selection of fresh, local seafood and Certified Black Angus Beef. Ginny Lane has been a must visit for over a decade, with daily live music and a beautiful patio overlooking the intracoastal waterway. We have an impressive list of weekly specials, and a kid's menu that is available all day. In addition to our delicious food, we also offer quite a selection of craft brews and cocktails, creative martinis, and wine.
 
 Whether it's date night, a family outing, or a reunion amongst friends, Ginny Lane Bar and Grill is the perfect spot to indulge in some mouthwatering food and cocktails, while enjoying a fun and laid-back atmosphere.
